cases.name: no-match
cases.comment: registered secret does not occur in the input; nothing changes

cases.name: long-secret-masked-mid-token
cases.comment: len>=7 is masked unconditionally, even embedded with no boundaries

cases.name: short6-word-boundary-masked
cases.comment: len==6 is still short (4-6); delimited on both sides it is masked

cases.name: short6-not-boundary-survives
cases.comment: len==6 embedded mid-token is left untouched

cases.name: short4-word-boundary-masked
cases.comment: len==4 delimited by spaces on both sides is masked

cases.name: short5-word-boundary-punct-masked
cases.comment: len==5 delimited by space and punctuation is masked

cases.name: short4-not-boundary-survives
cases.comment: len==4 embedded mid-token is left untouched

cases.name: short5-not-boundary-survives
cases.comment: len==5 embedded mid-token is left untouched

cases.name: short4-string-start-masked
cases.comment: start-of-string counts as a boundary; space closes the right side

cases.name: short4-string-end-masked
cases.comment: end-of-string counts as a boundary; space opens the left side

cases.name: short5-single-boundary-survives
cases.comment: one boundary is not enough; string start but non-boundary (alphanumeric) right side

cases.name: short4-underscore-boundary-masked
cases.comment: underscore is non-alphanumeric, so str.isalnum treats it as a word boundary
